coordinateSystem: Three.js: x=east, y=T.P. metres, z=-north; local origin from KPR

cause.clipAlgorithm: Phase 2A clipped_runs splits OSM segments at the park polygon and retains only inside intervals; Phase 2C preserves two runs without auto-joining them.
cause.visualCandidateSource: Phase 2F added a collision-disabled straight visual span after the clip; its height is linearly interpolated from estimated Phase 2C endpoints.

connectionCandidate.heightMethod: cubic Bezier XY tangent match; smoothstep interpolation between Phase 2H estimated run endpoint elevations; no surveyed deck heights

limitations: This is a DEV-only geometric experiment, not a measured bridge surface.
The curve interpolates an OSM boundary clip gap; it does not establish physical deck continuity.
The hypothetical 100.555m probe checks absence of connection geometry, not the actual location of the unmodeled bridge extent.
No terrain/structural support data validates the connection candidate.
